findings.trigger: Callback/observer/persistence/release callable does not return; or finite phase clock decreases.
findings.expected: Original600s history/10800s phase bounds require actual bounded calls or enforceable parent admission, not only post-return rejection; clock evidence must be monotonic.
findings.actual: _authorize and _bounded invoke callables synchronously and check elapsed only after return/finally; persistence and receipt writes also have no preemptive bound. A bounded synthetic callback returns only after simulated10801s before rejection. Decreasing finite clock allows all16 to PASS. No intentionally hung process was launched. Native HTTP has absolute request/socket deadlines in _request and owned cancellation, but observer callbacks in request are synchronous; these semantics do not bound arbitrary callbacks or guarantee the entire phase.
findings.original_disposition: ADDITIONAL_ORIGINAL_OBLIGATION_PARTIAL: late SUCCESS history rejection fixed, hard callable bounds/monotonic phase clock not proved
